text: MessageScroll has paired Parent/Child module files in actor packaging and a MailGlue actor registration. The accepted registration now uses mail-message and safeForUntrustedWebProcess, whereas the assigned landing uses single-page. Preserve module, registration and message-manager group checks together in this actor family. The current group is later accepted context, not a feature introduced by the original reland. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Register both actor roles and their message-browser scope together
